summary: Sandbach United secured a dramatic 1-0 victory over Brereton Social, with Robbie Hatton firing home a far post volley in added time to snatch all three points. It was a tight, defensive affair with few clear-cut chances, but The Bach showed character to grab the winner when it mattered most. The squad also made substitutions late on, bringing on Fowles and Pollard to help close out the match.
